verdict.rationale: The Nevada Secretary of State is a government filing and records service, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product type. The evidence pack only shows bot walls on its robots.txt endpoints and contains nothing indicating the product ships any MCP client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
